harness.note: the real machine code of the functions named, over a world built from the real command table; presentation, queue and sound calls replaced by recorders.

description: The timer value A after a number of controller frames and the damage the scale override returns with A and B in float32 seconds.
notes: in.limit is B in seconds (Spiral Cut, Slice and Dice, Energy Rain 3; Blitz Ace 2; Shooting Star, Dragon Fang, Banishing Blade 4; Tornado 3), in.frame the controller frame the input was accepted in (counted from 1); a frame at which the timer value is no longer above 0 is not listed (the input is refused).

out.aBits is the float32 bit pattern of A the real timer (0x891ac0) holds after in.frame ticks at 30 a second; out.scaled[i] is the damage the real scale override (0x78bd90) returns for defaults.damages[i] with A = out.aBits and B = in.limit as float32 seconds.

The old engine fed the override float32 milliseconds; for the instants the game produces (whole 1/30 s frames) about 1 percent of (instant, damage) pairs differ by one point between the two (FFX-G01 section 10 row 22).
name: overdrive_scale
